Group rides in Long Beach, CA

10 recurring group rides around Long Beach, CA: 7 road, 4 mixed, 3 social. 3 roll on weeknights, 6 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Long Beach Bicycling Meetup Wednesday Ride in Long Beach — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? HB Velo Sunday Morning Shop Ride runs 18 mph average.
